required_components.source: Original m416 BMPs; teal vest/bandanna, gray trousers, brown cuffed boots, red-brown sash, left leather gauntlet, right bare hand, red-brown hair.
Native raised one-hand idle and two-hand aimed fire; wood stock, transverse curved bow, string and bolt.
Native anatomical right hip with pale bolt fletchings.

motion_plan.Standing: CrossbowIdle torso breathing plus native raised right-hand carry; left hand relaxed.

motion_plan.Running: Mixamo Standard Run source foot trajectories; carry overlay.

G1.notes: Source motion prototype followed by equipped final playback; native raised carry and supported aim retained.

G4.notes: Sampled arm p99 peaks about 2.45x at the inspection shoulder versus the approximate 2x target. Close-up and continuous visual review retained; no skin collapse found. Four normalized weights match the delivered skin.

G5.notes: All clips checked at half-frame intervals. Largest reported hand-edge ratio 3.03x in Death, below approximate 4.5x guide; aimed supporting-hand error 0.013mm.

G6_G7.notes: Surface parity below .18mm. Loop seams below .004mm; held Dead exact. Normal and half-speed playback, native indoor/outdoor comparisons and combat captured.
